info.name: Smart Home API
info.description: Public Smart Home APIs. Explicit localhost addresses support Bruno import. Device, command and rule IDs match the existing test database; registration and command responses update the variables. Command requests generate a new Idempotency-Key each time; replace {{$guid}} with a fixed UUID to test retries. Telemetry pushes use the current time. Only host-accessible routes are included.

Data for the settings form. Does not poll equipment. Returns the model and connection address without passwords, tokens or credential_ref. The address must not contain embedded credentials.

Replaces all settings. When the connection changes, checks connectivity through the connectivity service. Applies the same compatibility checks as registration. If credential_ref is omitted, the existing secret reference is preserved: reading and saving the public form does not remove credentials.

item.name: Accept a measurement from a new sensor

request.description: PUSH sensors only. Validates type, metric and unit against the registry. Responds after persistence. Uniqueness: device_id + measurement_id. An identical retry returns 200; a different payload returns 409. Late measurements are stored but do not replace a newer measurement according to measured_at.
The client determines freshness from measured_at and its own age threshold; this request does not poll the device.
Interval [from, to), with from < to. Sorted by measured_at, then measurement_id, ascending. Empty history returns [].

Reads camera settings from the monolith and requests a link directly from the camera. The browser plays a compatible stream directly. Permanent camera credentials are not returned. Request a new link after expiry.

One measurement condition triggers one fixed action. Validates the metric, unit and target device type. A new rule starts with previous_match=false. A false-to-true transition triggers a run; stale measurements are skipped without changing the previous condition state.
List rules
Read a rule

Replaces all fields. Repeating the same values does not change previous_match or create a new run. When the rule changes, previous_match is reset to false; comparing fields, updating the rule and resetting the condition are atomic with respect to condition evaluation. Existing runs retain their original action snapshots.
Changing a disabled rule to enabled sets previous_match=false. Enabling an already enabled rule does not reset the condition. Disabling a rule does not cancel commands already sent.
Newest first: created_at DESC, id DESC. The run ID is used as the Idempotency-Key for the domain service. Commands and service mappings are defined in code; there are no action catalogs.
